scope: Reference set selected from individually owner-approved concepts. This does not approve a new concept or assert new family-level owner acceptance.
reviewCriteria: Material finish: neutral desaturated military surfaces, restrained contrast and comparable armor/mechanism material separation.
Armor construction: thick angular plates, substantial bevels and readable mechanical subassemblies with comparable treatment across chassis.
Detail scale: broad clean armor areas; vents, fasteners and seams remain subordinate at a matched presentation size.
Joints and interfaces: reinforced load-bearing pivots, protected waist connections and functional weapon attachments share the same industrial construction language.
Distinct chassis identity: preserve the requested role, silhouette, cockpit, leg anatomy, proportions and legal mounts; do not copy another reference chassis or blend their equipment.
